title: Allow specifying the searchBox form (submit button, reset button)
body:
It would be nice, for mobile experience for example, to be able to link the searchBox to a form so that we only search when the form is submitted.

What do you think?

It kind of look like the searchOnlyOnEnterKey option but with a form and maybe an `<input type="submit" />`

This could be done this way:

```js
searchBox({
  inputContainer: // the input to target, mandatory
  formContainer: // the wrapping form if you have any and want to have submit buttons or clear button (optional)
  searchAsYouType: true/false (default to true)
});
```

Once a formContainer is passed, we should listen for reset and submit events on it if needed.

We would need to stop documenting `searchOnlyOnEnterKey..` and `container` for this widget, even if they should keep working.
